source: Stock night traffic with a signal graphic added to the image. This is a simulation: the graphic is treated as the real signal of the road.
assumptions: The signal graphic governs every lane that crosses the stop line.
The stop line follows the painted line across the lanes, from the kerb on the left to the barrier on the right.
Coordinates of the stop line are pixels of the reference frame, because the camera moves.
Vehicles come toward the camera, so a box's bottom edge is taken as the vehicle's front.
